definition: relating to, cut or turned up by, a plough.
example_en: New seeds were sown in the ploughed land.

definition: the act or process of breathing.
example_en: The process of breathing supplies oxygen to the body.

definition: slanting or bending from a direct line or course; oblique; inclined.
example: ಆ ಗೋಡೆಯು ಒಂದು ಕಡೆ ಒರಚಾಗಿ ಬಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: That wall is bent obliquely on one side.

definition: an insect of the family of Lampyridae, whose abdomens usu. glow with a luminescent light; fire-fly.
example_en: The firefly was glimmering in the dark night.

definition: a mode of fertilization in which the sperm of a male fertilises the ovum of a female within the latter's body.
example_en: In some organisms internal fertilization takes place.

definition: to bow one's head as a token of reverence.
example_en: He bowed his head and paid respects before the teachers.

definition: to carry the burden on one's head, shoulder, back, etc.
example: ಆ ಹೆಂಗಸು ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯ ಹೊರೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊರುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: That woman carries a bundle of firewood on her head.

definition: extraordinary valour.
example_en: Everyone praised that soldier's extraordinary valour.

definition: any of broad-bodied, four-winged, six-footed, hairy hymenopteran insects which belong to a large super family Apoidea, which gather pollen and nectar, have biting as well as sucking mouthparts, and often live in organised colonies.
example_en: Bees collect nectar from flowers.

definition: to stay, sojourn (at a place) for relatively longer period.
example_en: The pilgrims sojourned at the monastery for a longer period.

definition: eminence; greatness; excellence.
example_en: Everyone praised that great man's eminence.

definition: a powder used to clean the teeth; tooth-powder.
example_en: I brought new tooth-powder from the shop.

definition: to encourage to be bold; to give courage to; to embolden.
example_en: The teacher emboldened his student and sent him to battle.

definition: an arrow; a shaft-missile.
example_en: The hunter shot an arrow from the bow.

definition: (fig.) a goldsmith.
example: ಜನರು ತಮಾಷೆಗೆ ಅವನನ್ನು ಹೇಮಚೋರ ಎಂದು ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: People jokingly called him the 'gold thief', meaning the goldsmith.

definition: the condition of being destitute.
example_en: During the famine, the villagers suffered from destitution.

definition: a man who is satisfied.
example_en: After the meal, he sat down satisfied.

definition: to get collected, gathered or amassed.
example_en: The money got collected in the line.

definition: a written guarantee or assurance given against default by another.
example_en: He gave a written guarantee for the loan.

definition: a haughty, arrogant person.
example_en: The arrogant person does not listen to anyone's words.

definition: an eating of meat or flesh or an instance of it.
example_en: The doctor advised reducing the eating of meat.

definition: (pl.) the veins at the nape of the neck.
example_en: The veins at the nape of her neck had tightened from strain.

definition: to get bewildered, perplexed.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನು ತಳವೆಳಗಾಗಿ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: Hearing that question, he became utterly bewildered.

definition: the plant Gomphrena globosa of Amaranthaceae family.
example: ಅವಳ ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ದೊಡ್ಡಗೋರಟೆ ಹೂವು ಅರಳಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The gomphrena flower had bloomed in front of her house.

definition: a smooth, fast pace of a horse.
example: ಆ ಕುದುರೆಯ ನಾಗಾಲೋಟ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That horse's smooth, fast gallop won everyone's admiration.

definition: a kind of creeper.
example_en: The gaṇapeyabaḷḷi creeper grew in the backyard.

definition: shame; embarrassment; humiliation.
example_en: Losing in front of everyone became a humiliation for him.

definition: to draw towards or nearer.
example_en: That light drew the moths towards itself.

definition: the art or performing skill of producing baffling effects or illusions by sleight of hand, concealed apparatus, etc.; magic; jugglery.
example_en: The magician performed magic on the stage.

definition: a sweet song.
example_en: The singer sang a sweet song on the stage.

definition: joyfully; with pleasure; pleasingly; gratifyingly.
example_en: She welcomed the guests joyfully.

definition: to fashion, mould, carve etc. in a definite shape; to shape or sculpt.
example_en: The sculptor shaped the stone into a beautiful idol.

definition: (shivering) with a violent, and quick motion.
example_en: The child shivered violently in the cold.

definition: (a heterogenous compound) (biol.) a making of two female reproductive cells or female individuals fruitful by pollinating or impregnating with the male gametes; double fertilisation.
example: ಸಸ್ಯಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞರು ಆ ಹೂವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರ್ನಿಷೇಚನ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The botanists studied the process of double fertilisation in that flower.

definition: to call, invite, summon a person to be present or to come.
example_en: The king summoned the ministers to the assembly.

definition: amounting to seventy two.
example_en: His father was seventy-two years old.

definition: a cry, call in response to another cry or call.
example_en: An answering cry was heard in response to his call on the hill.

definition: (said of birds) to pick up food by pecking with the beak.
example_en: The hen was pecking up the grain.

definition: a book containing models of handwriting, used in teaching penmanship a copybook.
example_en: The teacher gave the students a copybook.

definition: actually; really; in fact.
example_en: What he said was actually true.

definition: to cut into two slices; to split.
example_en: The hunter cut the creeper into two.

definition: a hard, bivalve outer covering, as of mollusk, insect, egg, etc.; a shell.
example_en: The shell of that snail was hard.

definition: cracking of the fingers.
example_en: In his nervousness, he cracked his fingers.

definition: air, that carries odour to different places.
example_en: The scent-bearing breeze carried the flower's fragrance far away.

definition: a partition to separate, conceal, shelter or protect; a curtain; a screen.
example_en: They had put up a screen in the middle of the room.

definition: to scratch with the fingers or toes.
example_en: The cat scratched the tree with its claws.

definition: a meaningful, significant words or speech.
example_en: Everyone liked the teacher's meaningful words.

definition: to snap a finger and the thumb to roduce a sharp, short cracking sound.
example_en: The boy snapped his fingers and called his friend.

definition: to have immediately; to get or possess immediately.
example_en: He immediately got the property that he was to possess.

definition: an ornamental metal (esp. of gold or silver) band or chain worn around the wrist; a bracelet.
example: ಅವಳ ಕೈಗೆ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಕಡಗ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The gold bracelet suited her wrist well.

definition: a domestic servant (esp.in a feudal system).
example: ಶ್ರೀಮಂತರ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮನೆದೊಂಡ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: A domestic servant did all the work in the rich man's house.

definition: any round body or figure having the surface equally distant from the centre at all points; a globe; a ball.
example_en: They manufacture electric equipment in that factory.

definition: one's hand.
example_en: The teacher gave blessings with his own hand.

definition: the quality or state of being clean; cleanliness.
example_en: Maintaining cleanliness of the house is good for health.

definition: the drainings of jaggery or crude sugar; treacle; molasses.
example: ಬೆಲ್ಲ ತಯಾರಿಸುವಾಗ ಕಾಕವಿ ಬೇರೆ ಪಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: While making jaggery, they collected the molasses in a separate vessel.

definition: a number that is one of a series; serial number.
example_en: Every student has been given a serial number.

definition: (dial.) that portion of the jaw that holds the back or grinding teeth.
example_en: The toothache was severe in the back of his jaw.

definition: a hurrying or being hurried, esp. from eagerness, anxiety; hurry.
example: ರೋಗಿಯನ್ನು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಸಾಗಿಸುವ ಧಾವಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಓಡಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone rushed about in the hurry to take the patient to the hospital.

definition: one's previous life.
example_en: People say that in his previous life he was a yogi.

definition: a movable cover, hinged or unattached, as for a box, trunk, pot, etc.; a lid.
example: ಅವಳು ಮಡಕೆಯ ಮುಚ್ಚುಳ್ ತೆಗೆದು ಒಳಗೆ ನೋಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She removed the lid of the pot and looked inside.

definition: any of the panacean herbs that is believed to cure all diseases or ills; a cure-all herb.
example_en: People believe the cure-all herb to be a medicine for all diseases.

definition: to utter a sound; to produce a vocal sound.
example_en: The child uttered some sound joyfully.

definition: a kind of disease; .
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ನರಮಾಲೆ ಎಂಬ ರೋಗವಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said he had a disease called naramale.

definition: air-passage from the throat to the lungs; the wind-pipe.
example_en: A piece of food got stuck in the wind-pipe.

definition: the quality of having a mixture of two or more qualities (esp. of two different cultures, linguistic communities, etc.).
example: ಆ ನಗರದ ಹಂಡಬಂಡತನವು ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಆಹಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಉಡುಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The mixture of two cultures in that city is visible in its food and clothing.

definition: a talisman tied to a woman who is pregnant with her first child.
example: ಮೊದಲ ಮಗುವನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತ ಗರ್ಭಿಣಿಗೆ ಅತ್ತೆ ಗೊಂಟಿಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother-in-law tied a talisman to the pregnant woman carrying her first child.

definition: arbitration by settling the differences by concession from both the parties involved, the process of which need not be as per or bound by, the rules.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಜಗಳ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಖಾಜಿನ್ಯಾಯದಿಂದ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: Both of them stopped quarreling and settled by mutual concession.

definition: that which is difficult to get.
example_en: This medicine is hard to get; it is not available anywhere.

definition: (phil.) an erroneous conception; mistaken notion; a misconception.
example: ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಥ್ಯಾಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಬೇರೂರಿ ಸತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಲಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: A mistaken notion took root in his mind and he could not accept the truth.

definition: a committee, group of persons empowered and required to administer; an executive committee or board.
example: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಕಾರಿಣಿ ಸಭೆ ಸೇರಿ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: The organization's executive committee met and took a decision.

definition: an eye with the eye-ball projecting out.
example_en: That old woman had a bulging eye.

definition: any of several hand tools (of a workman, craftsman, etc.).
example_en: The blacksmith had kept his hand tools carefully.

definition: a stopper or closer of a bottle or can made of bark of some trees, rubber, plastic, etc.
example_en: He pulled out the stopper of the bottle.

definition: all the time; always.
example_en: He always speaks only the truth.

definition: to see or considered as equal or similar to.
example_en: They considered that work as important.

definition: a half prosodic instant.
example_en: A half prosodic instant is used in this poem.

definition: torn out by the roots; uprooted; eradicated.
example_en: The trees uprooted by the storm lay across the road.

definition: a chequered or colourful carpet.
example_en: They had kept the colourful carpet folded beside the wall.

definition: a big earthen vessel for porridge.
example_en: There was a big earthen vessel for porridge in the corner of the kitchen.

definition: the quality of being disciplined, well-trained, self-controlled and law-abiding.
example_en: The soldier's discipline earned everyone's admiration.

definition: a bag, sack, pouch or pocket.
example_en: The old man took a coin out of the pouch.

definition: the state of being pith-dark; pitch-darkness.
example_en: Pitch darkness had spread inside the forest.

definition: to include, contain (without oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: That list includes the entire district.

definition: (said of cattle) to eat; to graze.
example_en: The cows were grazing grass in the field.

definition: (dance.) rhythmic and measured movement of hands, legs, head, etc.
example_en: The dancer performed the rhythmic movements in perfect time.

definition: to be peaceful or regain peace, calmness.
example_en: After the reconciliation, the two families regained peace.

definition: (beauty) to become conspicuous.
example_en: When she wore ornaments, her beauty became conspicuous.

definition: a caste the members of which are chiefly engaged in catching fish for living.
example: ತೊಱೆಯ ಜನರು ಮೀನು ಹಿಡಿಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The people of the fishing caste make their living by catching fish.

definition: the total amount of goods on hand in a store, etc.; inventory; stock.
example_en: The inventory in the warehouse is good.

definition: butter recently separated from curds; fresh butter.
example_en: Grandmother fed fresh butter every morning.

definition: an expert in the art and science of sculpture.
example_en: That sculpture expert created beautiful statues.

definition: one whose profession is to grind grains into flours.
example_en: The flour-grinder grinds finger-millet every day.

definition: the hollow under the arm at the shoulder; the armpit.
example_en: While bathing, one should dry the armpit well.

definition: a cluster of villagers or towns.
example_en: This cluster of villages is made up of many hamlets.

definition: that which is not desirable; a diabolical, wicked thing.
example_en: That minister's plan turned out to be a wicked, undesirable thing.

definition: to become stiff, tight.
example_en: His hands and legs became stiff from the cold.

definition: a genus of bird.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಡುಕ ಎಂಬ ಹಕ್ಕಿಯ ಕೂಗು ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: In the forest, the call of the bird called anduka was heard.

definition: any belief, based on fear or ignorance, that is inconsistent with the known laws of science or with what is generally considered in the particular society as true and rational; esp., such a belief in charms, omens, the supernatural, etc.; a superstition.
example: ಬೆಕ್ಕು ದಾರಿ ದಾಟಿದರೆ ಅಪಶಕುನ ಎಂಬುದು ಕುರುಡುನಂಬುಗೆ.
example_en: The idea that a cat crossing the path is a bad omen is a superstition.

definition: in any way, manner; by someway; somehow.
example_en: Somehow this work must be finished.

definition: to talk excitedly.
example_en: He spoke, talking excitedly out of anger.

definition: a person who is adamantly and rigidly firm in will, purpose, opinion.
example_en: Being a rigidly firm man, he did not change his decision.

definition: to liberate a person, animal, nation etc. (from the arbitrary control of another); to liberate.
example_en: The freedom fighters liberated the nation.

definition: one who is enjoying a property taken on sub-lease or sub-tenancy; a sub-lessee or sub-tenant.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಒಳ ಅನುಭವದಾರ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The sub-tenant of that house paid the rent.

definition: objectionable - a) open to objection; b) disagreeable; offensive.
example_en: His conduct appeared objectionable.

definition: that which is determined, decided or settled.
example_en: This is a matter decided in the meeting.

definition: to throw with force.
example_en: He threw the stone against the wall with force.

definition: a large stack of hay.
example_en: There was a large stack of hay in the threshing yard.

definition: an excellent, meritorious man.
example_en: Everyone gives respect to the excellent man of the town.

definition: mental suffering; sadness; grief; sorrow.
example: ಮಗನ ಸಾವಿನ ದುಕ್ಕ ಆಕೆಯನ್ನು ಇನ್ನೂ ಕಾಡುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: The grief of her son's death still haunts her.

definition: the act or an instance of cheating.
example_en: His act of cheating caused loss to the customers.

definition: a pitiless, cruel man.
example_en: That pitiless man listened to no one's words.

definition: a going on a journey or the course of journey.
example_en: The course of his journey was very slow.

definition: anything that is remaining; remainder; balance.
example_en: The remaining money was in the bag.

definition: not vivid; not brilliant; dim; dull.
example_en: The reflection in the old mirror was dull.

definition: to push back.
example_en: The police pushed the crowd back.

definition: the building which a monk lives in; a monastery.
example_en: The swami lives in the monastery.

definition: a boat-shaped dish, for holding water.
example_en: They filled water in the boat-shaped dish for worship.

definition: a water jar.
example_en: They filled the water needed for worship in the water jar.

definition: a daily sacrifice a householder has to do.
example_en: Performing the daily cooking sacrifice is the duty of a householder.

definition: a thick and complex growth of thorns.
example: ಗಿಡಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಮುಳುದೊಡಕು ಬೆಳೆದು ದಾರಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A thick tangle of thorns had grown among the plants and blocked the path.

definition: the plant Anamirta paniculata (= A. cocculus, = Cocculus indicus) of Menispermaceae family.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ವಿಷಪ್ರಾಶನಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾಕಮಾರಿ ಬೀಜದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor warned about the kakamari seed causing poisoning.

definition: sympahy that is expressed in words; compassionate speech.
example_en: Her compassionate words comforted the grieving.

definition: the quality or condition of being clean, spotless; cleanliness; immaculateness.
example_en: It is important to maintain cleanliness in the temple.

definition: a man of cool temperment.
example_en: That cool-tempered teacher never got angry.

definition: a swollen, bulged part (of the body).
example: ಗಾಯದ ಸುತ್ತ ದದ್ದರ ಉಂಟಾಗಿ ನೋವು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A swollen bulge formed around the wound, increasing the pain.

definition: awakened (from sleep); aroused.
example_en: The disciple's mind was awakened by the guru's words.

definition: a flood of woes.
example_en: A flood of woes engulfed his life.

definition: to do services or duties for; to give service to; to serve.
example_en: That servant served his master faithfully.

definition: to permit or allow to go.
example_en: The father lovingly bid farewell and let his daughter go.

definition: the path trodden by animals (which is followed by hunters to hunt or catch them).
example: ಬೇಟೆಗಾರರು ಜಿಂಕೆಯ ಸರವಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೋದರು.
example_en: The hunters followed the deer's trodden path into the forest.

definition: the crane Leptoptilus dubius; adjutant crane.
example_en: The adjutant crane was searching for food in the marshland.

definition: a tax collecting officer.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಸುಂಕಿಗ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ತೆರಿಗೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The village tax collector used to collect taxes every month.

definition: of, relating to, produced by honey-bees.
example_en: The honey-bees filled the hive with their honey-related store.

definition: one who tends cows; a cowherd.
example_en: The cowherd took the cows to the forest early in the morning.

definition: a strong contestant, competitor.
example_en: That player was regarded as a strong contestant in the match.

definition: giving an indication, suggestion or intimation; showing; signifying; indicative.
example_en: His silence was indicative of consent.

definition: a girl who has recently attained menstrual stage.
example_en: Relatives gathered for the celebration of the girl who had recently attained menstrual stage.

definition: not desiring; desireless.
example_en: The ascetic was desireless of all wishes.

definition: (poetry) sweet lip.
example_en: The poet wrote in praise of the heroine's sweet lip.

definition: till this or present time.
example_en: He has not come until now.

definition: to be decorated with paints and designs.
example_en: The wall was decorated with paintings and designs.

definition: the cowdung.
example_en: Farmers use cowdung as fertilizer.

definition: a monkey.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಬಲೀಮುಖ ಮರದಿಂದ ಮರಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾರಿತು.
example_en: In the forest, a monkey jumped from tree to tree.

definition: the supreme knowledge.
example_en: He obtained the supreme knowledge from the guru.

definition: the pod of any leguminous plant.
example_en: They split open the pod and took out the seeds inside.

definition: a strong wish or craving; a desire.
example_en: She had a desire to go abroad.

definition: the backside of the body.
example_en: When he fell, the backside of his body got hurt.

definition: courage; valour; bravery.
example_en: With bravery, he faced the difficulties.

definition: (hist.) a kind of tax.
example: ಹೊಲೆಸುಂಕ ಆ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಕೆಲಸಗಾರರ ಮೇಲೆ ವಿಧಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The holesunka tax was imposed on the workers of that region.

definition: a particular disease.
example_en: He has developed rakta vata (a joint disease) in his joints.

definition: a kind of percussion instrument; a small drum.
example_en: The artist played the small drum at the festival.

definition: a cluster of stars, outside our galaxy, looking like a bright sheet or hazy cover in the sky; a nebula.
example_en: The nebula in the sky appeared clearly through the telescope.

definition: (used to modify the verb grieve) excessively.
example: ಮಗನ ಸಾವಿನಿಂದ ಆಕೆ ಮಿಡಮಿಡ ಎಂದು ಮರುಗಿದಳು.
example_en: She grieved excessively over the death of her son.

definition: a going round (in circle).
example_en: The children went round in circles on the ground.

definition: absolutely free from mundane desires and attachments; finally emancipated.
example_en: That great soul was finally emancipated from all desires.

definition: to be accomplished, fulfilled.
example_en: His plan was finally accomplished.

definition: a pig, hog or boar.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಶೂಕರ ಗಿಡಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಓಡಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A boar was roaming among the plants in the forest.

definition: any of the important veins of the body.
example_en: The surgeon was careful about the important vein.

definition: a starchy foodstuff derived from the soft interior of the trunk of various palms and cycads, used in making pāyasa (a sweet in liquid form), papads, puddings, etc.; sago.
example_en: Mother used sago for the pāyasa.

definition: either of the external openings of the nose; a nostril.
example_en: The elephant's nostril was wide.

definition: brightness; lustre; brilliance.
example: ಆ ಕಿರೀಟದ ರಾಜತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಕಣ್ಣು ಕುಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: The brilliance of that crown dazzled everyone's eyes.

definition: orderly; neatly; tidily.

definition: a kind of worm.

example_en: A kind of worm called lulli bred in the rotten fruit.

definition: to grow along the ground or a wall, as some plants; to creep.
example_en: The creeper grew, creeping along the wall.

definition: act of holding back in doubt or indecision; hesitation.
example_en: He felt hesitation while taking the decision.

definition: an arresting or being arrested; a taking or being taken into custody.
example_en: The arrest of the thief took place at the police station.

definition: a kind of song sung usu. on occasion of marriages.
example_en: The women sang a marriage song on the occasion of the wedding.

definition: to sink downward by weight or pressure; to become smaller; to shrink.
example_en: The mound of earth sank down under the pressure.

definition: (hist.) a copper coin equal to a quarter of an anna or sixty fourth part of a rupee.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸ್ತುವೊಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಪಾವಾಣೆ ಬೆಲೆಯಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In those days, an item cost one pāvāṇe coin.

definition: a group of musicians playing together, upon wind and percussion instruments; a band.
example_en: A band played music in the procession.

definition: a dangerous infectious disease, which is caused by intestinal infection with the bacterium Vibrio cholerae and is characterised by severe vomiting and diarrhoea leading to dehydration; cholera.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಲರ ರೋಗ ಹರಡಿ ಅನೇಕರು ಸತ್ತರು.
example_en: Cholera spread in that village and many people died.

definition: a good job or work.
example_en: Everyone agreed that this was a good job.

definition: the profession of the bodyguard of a king.
example_en: His family lived by the profession of guarding the king.

definition: the fixed gaze (of a person).
example_en: Her fixed gaze was set toward the door.

definition: one who walks or moves fast.
example_en: Being a fast walker, he reached before everyone else.

definition: (math.) a straight line continually approaching but never meeting a curve; tangent to a curve at infinity; an asymptote.
example_en: The mathematics teacher explained about the asymptote.

definition: a postal mail or message sent through a person.
example_en: He sent a message through his friend.

definition: the act of cooperating secretly (with someone), esp. in wrongdoing; connivance.
example: ಆ ಪಿತೂರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಷೆರೀಕು ಇತ್ತೆಂದು ಸಾಬೀತಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It was proved that he had connived in that conspiracy.

definition: religious defilement caused by the birth of a baby to the members of the family.
example_en: In the house where the baby was born, they observe the ritual defilement period.

definition: the act or an instance of shouting or calling out noisily; an outcry; bellowing; bawling.
example_en: During the night riot, the shouting of the people was heard.

definition: an artificial waterway for transportation or irrigation; a canal.
example_en: The farmers let water into the field through the canal.

definition: want of fertilisation.
example_en: That plant did not bear fruit due to lack of fertilisation.

definition: the act of gathering, putting together; accumulation.
example_en: The accumulation of books took place in the library.

definition: cold water.
example_en: Drinking cold water when thirsty gives relief.

definition: a defensive coat; an armour.
example_en: That warrior entered the field wearing the defensive armour.

definition: suddenly; all of a sudden.
example_en: The fire went out suddenly.

definition: a literary work of little literary value.
example_en: Nobody read that worthless literary work.

definition: trivial; trifling; little.
example: ಆ ವಿಷಯ ಫಲ್ಗು ಎಂದು ಅವರು ಕಡೆಗಣಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They dismissed that matter as trivial.

definition: to feel intense sorrow, grief; to grieve, mourn.
example: ಮಗನ ಸಾವಿನ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ತಾಯಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಹಳವಳಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: On hearing news of her son's death, the mother grieved deeply.

definition: to reply, response in rude manner.
example_en: He replied rudely and annoyed everyone.

definition: any of several breeds of hunting dog that find game either by scenting and tracking; a hound.
example_en: The hunter took the hunting hound and went into the forest.

example_en: The earthworm crawled along the ground.

definition: operation - a) the condition of being in action or at work; b) a process or action that is part of a series in some work.
example_en: This machine's operation is running smoothly.

example_en: The large honey-bee had built its hive on the mountain rock.

definition: wet, soft earth or earthy matter, as on the ground after rain, at the bottom of a pond or along the banks of a river; mire; mud.
example_en: Mud stuck to the feet in the field, making it hard to walk.

definition: to happen; to become obvious or conspicuous.
example_en: After the rain stopped, the river became conspicuous (swelled).

example_en: No one spoke to that ugly-looking boy.

example_en: The prime minister's wife sat respectfully in the assembly.

definition: any of large gruiform wading birds of Gruidae family, with very long legs and neck, and a long, straight bill; a crane.
example_en: The crane catches fish in the water.

definition: people participating in a meeting.
example_en: The assembly's participants gathered before the meeting began.

definition: (dial.) a woman of black complexion.
example: ಆ ಕರ್ಚಿ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಗಳು ಗದ್ದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That dark-complexioned woman was working in the field.

definition: the state or quality of being literate i.e. ability to read and write.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈಗ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಓದುಬರಹ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Now everyone in that village is literate.

definition: to use, wield a weapon; to hit, injure or kill another with a weapon.
example_en: The guards wielded weapons and protected them from the wild animals.

definition: the religious merit which would bring one favourable fruits; virtue.
example: ಸೇವೆ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಸೈಪು ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ನಂಬಿಕೆ.
example_en: It is believed that virtue is gained by rendering service.

definition: a children-play.

definition: a fragment of a rock; a stone.

example_en: That novel came to be regarded as the writer's masterpiece.

definition: something that is very small; a tiny thing.
example_en: A tiny thing had fallen on the table.

definition: any of various painful conditions of the joints and muscles, characterised by inflammation, stiffness, etc., including rheumatoid arthritis; rheumatism.
example_en: Rheumatism began to trouble him in old age.

definition: a snake, that is supposed to live on air (without food).
example: ಗಾಳಿಕೂಳ ಮರದ ಪೊಟರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say the air-eating snake lives in the hollow of a tree.

definition: a pain in the eye.
example_en: Dust got in and caused her eye pain.

definition: a card or a sheet of paper, on which message is or intended to be, sent by post; a postal letter; a post card.
example_en: I wrote a post card to her.

definition: uselessness; worthlessness.

example_en: That old machine is now mere uselessness.

definition: a female dog; a bitch.
example_en: That bitch was nursing her pups.

definition: a harmless, moderate-sized, tropical lizard, Iguana tuberculata of Iguanidae family, having a row of spines from neck to tail, which is known for its grip and used in scaling forts, and which feeds on insects or vegetation; the common iguana.
example_en: The iguana was climbing up the fort wall.

definition: having hands or hand-like limbs.
example_en: That idol has hands, it has four hands.

definition: to occur by chance; to come into being or occur as an event, process or result.
example_en: A good thing occurred by chance.

definition: any of the four equal parts of something; a fourth; a quarter.
example_en: The brothers divided the land into quarter shares.

definition: a soft, white, downy substance consisting of the hairs or fibers attached to the seeds of plants belonging to the genus Gossypium, of the mallow family, used in making fabrics, thread, wadding, etc.; cotton.
example_en: They spin cotton into thread and make cloth.

definition: the tree Breynia rhamnoides of Euphorbiaceae family; coaral berry tree.
example: ಕಾಡುನುಗ್ಗೆ ಮರವು ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The coral berry tree had grown at the foot of that hill.

definition: a list of prices of commodities (available for sale).
example_en: The shopkeeper pasted the price list on the wall.

definition: to sip with a sound.
example_en: The child drank the milk, sipping it with a sound.

definition: the act or an instance of swelling.
example: ಕಾಲಿಗಾದ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿನ ಉಬ್ಬಿಕೆ ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಇತ್ತು.

definition: a very thin film of water forming a ball around air or gas; a water-bubble.

definition: filled with despondency; dejected; despondent.

definition: a gazing fixedly at.

definition: the black bumble-bee.

definition: to become or be a friend of; to make friends with; to associate (intimately) with.

definition: of the current time.

definition: a jeering at; a derisive gibe.

definition: a poet who has got the poetic talent by birth.
example_en: That born poet had been writing poems since childhood.

definition: the act or power of illusion.
example_en: The audience was amazed by the magician's illusion.

definition: an armour worn by a soldier that protects the body against weapons.
example_en: The soldier wore his armour and went to battle.

definition: going on, happening or extending without interruption; continuous.
example_en: This work is going on continuously.

example_en: That hanged man was found in the morning.

definition: a rotary outflow of air from an area of high pressure.
example_en: The rotary outflow of air blew strongly over the sea.

definition: the ability or qualifications (for or to do, something); skill, expertness or talent one has; the practical ability; competence; strength, stamina or vigour required for carrying out an act.

definition: the quality of being, tendency to keep (something) beautiful, charming or tidy.

definition: the front portion (of something).

definition: a circular weapon with sharp blades, a disc.

definition: to challenge; to throw down the gauntlet.

definition: a great quantity or store of money, valuable possessions, property or other riches; wealth; opulence.

definition: a class of lower female deities, who wait on gods and beings reborn in heaven, delighting them with song and dance.

definition: a thatched roof (of a house).

example_en: Shingles causes blisters on the skin.

definition: a kind of liquid food made using dhal, spices, etc. for mixing it with rice.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಬಿಸಿ ಅನ್ನದ ಜೊತೆ ಸಾಱು ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother made sāṛu to go with hot rice.

definition: (pl.) very narrow places or lanes.
example_en: There are many very narrow lanes in the old market.

definition: the way, manner or position a thing is; condition; state; being; entity.
example_en: His presence brought comfort to everyone.

definition: a long tract of land, along a canal, reserved for making a mound on.
example: ಕಾಲುವೆಯ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಏರಿಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ದಿಬ್ಬ ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: They built an earthen mound on the tract reserved along the canal.

definition: a more or less cylindrical roll of tobacco cured for smoking, wrapped in a tobacco leaf; a cigar.
example_en: He had the habit of smoking a cigar every day.

definition: bodily confort or pleasure.
example: ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರಿನ ಸ್ನಾನದಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮೈಸುಖ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: He got bodily comfort from the hot water bath.

definition: the leguminous plant Dolichos lablab (var. typicum) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The lablab bean vine had spread in the backyard of the house.

definition: a loan paid to a person by cash.
example_en: The farmer needed a cash loan for sowing.

definition: a kind of paddy.
example_en: This year the vaddala variety of paddy has grown well.

definition: causing wonder, great surprise.
example_en: His astonishing performance amazed everyone.

definition: unapproachablenes; inaccessibility.
example: ಆ ಗುಹೆಯ ಅಗಮ್ಯತೆಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ಯಾರೂ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of the inaccessibility of that cave, no one went there.

definition: agreeable to sight; attractive; delightful; beautiful.
example: ಆ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಮೂರ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ಜನ ಸೇರಿದರು.
example_en: People gathered to see that beautiful idol.

definition: an evil spirit; a devil; a demon.
example_en: In the story, a demon was terrorizing the village.

definition: a meditating on the Supreme Soul.
example_en: That sage engaged in meditation on the Supreme Soul every day.

definition: a sweet juice; anything that tastes delicious.
example_en: This fruit was overflowing with sweet, delicious juice.

definition: an expert cook.
example_en: That expert cook makes tasty food.

definition: radiant or luminous brightness; brilliance; lustre.
example_en: The sun's brilliance spread over the sea.

definition: a woman who is sitting or standing without moving.
example: ಆ ಸ್ತಿಮಿತಗಾತ್ರೆ ಬಾಗಿಲ ಬಳಿ ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That motionless woman sat quietly near the door.

definition: to act or work with another or others; to co-operate.
example: ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸಹಕರಿಸಿದರೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಬೇಗ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If everyone cooperates together, the work finishes quickly.
